def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marked = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in marked), max(r for r, c in marked)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in marked), max(c for r, c in marked)

    out = []
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        choices = []
        for s in range(h):
            if any(grid[s][c] == 8 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)):
                continue
            # Rows often repeat elsewhere in the grid; use the closest
            # matching complete visible row to reconstruct the covered run.
            score = sum(grid[r][c] == grid[s][c]
                        for c in range(w) if c < c0 or c > c1)
            choices.append((score, -abs(s - r), s))
        s = max(choices)[2]
        out.append(grid[s][c0:c1 + 1])
    return out
